name: threejs-previz
description: Cinematic previz in code: Three.js blocking scenes, a camera-move catalog, measured audits, and deterministic Remotion renders — motion references for generative video models.

scripts.render:film: pnpm audit:scenes && remotion render feature out/feature.mp4
scripts.render:film:stitch: pnpm audit:scenes && remotion render opening public/opening.mp4 && remotion render roundtable public/roundtable.mp4 && remotion render feature-stitch out/feature-stitch.mp4
